comparator_version_rule: This classification requires a new prospective comparator version. It does not change any historical comparator, threshold, evidence record, or verdict.

metrics.protected_property: A pointwise full-vocabulary envelope bounds every individual consumer-logit displacement on each canonical decision.
metrics.subsumption: Not subsumed. It protects an individual-coordinate property that RMS and p99 do not bound directly, and it remains the full-surface E_full prerequisite.
metrics.promotion_or_demotion_evidence: A future change needs a strategy proof that another core observation bounds every consumer-relevant coordinate under the same inputs and applicability key.

metrics.protected_property: An aggregate full-vocabulary energy envelope detects diffuse consumer-surface drift that a pointwise maximum limit does not quantify.
metrics.subsumption: Not subsumed by max-absolute difference because a maximum limit does not establish the permitted aggregate-error budget. It is separate from decision-local E_D, which covers only the semantic domain.
metrics.promotion_or_demotion_evidence: A future change needs a prospective theorem or direct strategy evidence that another core metric bounds the relevant aggregate consumer error without an unobserved consumer.

metrics.protected_property: The reducer describes upper-tail prevalence in the full vocabulary. For the current deterministic greedy semantic profile, no strategy theorem or independent consumer property requires that percentile after max-absolute difference, RMS, decision-local E_D, containment, and semantic stability pass.
metrics.subsumption: The current core contains a pointwise full-vocabulary bound for every p99 element, an aggregate full-vocabulary bound for diffuse drift, and decision-domain plus semantic controls for emitted behavior. This does not mathematically derive a numeric p99 limit; it establishes that p99 has no separately justified acceptance property in this comparator.
metrics.promotion_or_demotion_evidence: Promotion requires prospective strategy evidence of an independently correctness-bearing percentile property, such as a declared consumer or theorem whose safe operation depends on a quantile bound and is not covered by the other core gates.

metrics.protected_property: A decision-domain bound is a theorem prerequisite for containment and stability or ambiguity adjudication at each canonical decision.
metrics.subsumption: Not subsumed. Passing a full-vocabulary E_full limit does not prove the tighter per-decision E_D limit.
metrics.promotion_or_demotion_evidence: It may change only with a stronger prospective semantic theorem that replaces its prerequisite and preserves containment, tie, and decision semantics.

p99_telemetry_requirements: Retain the full-vocabulary reducer, decision coverage, finite-output check, provenance, and report for every qualification campaign.
A finite p99 reference-band exceedance creates telemetry health and focused revalidation work. It does not fail an otherwise passing new comparator qualification by itself.

capture_position_rule.requirement: Every acceptance-bearing FP32 consumer-logit metric and decision-local E_D applies to all eight teacher-forced canonical-prefix decisions. The case reducer is the maximum across those decisions where the metric has a case-level limit.
capture_position_rule.rationale: Issue #105 showed that an uncaptured canonical decision had a larger full-vocabulary max-absolute error than every retained capture-position observation. A subset therefore cannot establish the advertised all-canonical-decision property.
capture_position_rule.future_strategy_rule: A different strategy may declare a smaller canonical decision set only when its semantic contract proves that omitted decisions are outside the qualified consumer and semantic surface. Sampling a subset of otherwise in-scope canonical decisions is not permitted.
